reason: Verification failed at the complete stage due to a missing Docker path and the absence of a Docker-free smoke/CLI entrypoint. There are also critical correctness issues (small-world network construction, enforcement probability inversion) and misalignment with required metrics/validation. With one iteration remaining (54/54), a focused pass can restore operability (CLI/smoke), fix the most impactful correctness bugs, and align key outputs with the spec to maximize the chance of passing verification and evaluation.

specific_areas: Implement a real CLI main() with argparse supporting --smoke (tiny, Docker-free run), --input/--output, and --summary-only; keep the unconditional main() call to satisfy the sandbox.
Expose run_simulation(cfg=None) and avoid side effects on import; remove any no-op main() behavior that blocks CLI.
Fix small-world ring lattice: include wrap-around neighbors symmetrically and rewire from canonical (i<j) edges to preserve degree.
Correct enforcement probability: multiply by policy_stringency rather than divide.

Align ObservationAggregator outputs with the task spec: compute time_to_70_percent, sustained_adoption_days, peak_adoption_rate, policy_compliance_rate_in_mandated_locations (mean), mask_purchase_rate (mean per-capita), adoption_inequality_index (e.g., Gini over income quintiles), and rename stockout_days to supply_stockouts_days.
Use system-wide stockout detection (sum inventory <= 0) and quantity-weighted average prices for daily and overall metrics.
Add validation checks: adoption bounds, convergence (14-day MA stability), and supply-demand sanity with cumulative supply tracking.
Initialize Person.home_location_id and work_location_id explicitly; maintain workplace_id as an alias.
Harden weighted sampling against degenerate weights; remove stray pass statements.
Optional: Add --log-level to keep logs out of JSON by default.
